_note: Hand-computed BEFORE the checker was run against these fixtures. Every fixture asserts a FULL vector across all 14 rules, not just its target rule, so cross-talk between detectors is caught. Counts are {rule: [count_raw, count_capped]}; rules absent from a vector are asserted to be [0, 0]. Any change to a number here must be justified in PROGRESS.md, never fitted to the instrument's output.

h1_adverbial_list.md.why: Adverbial lead AND a genuine three-item list in the same sentence. Line 1 must count (the guard must not swallow it); line 2 must not (adverbial comma, no list). Added after a mutation test showed the guard was uncovered in this shape.

h4_date_daynumber.md.why: REGRESSION. Real Gemini prose wrote 'between January 1 and March 31'; H4 flagged the bare '1' as a spell-out-under-ten violation. Nobody writes 'January one'. Day numbers inside a date are date components, not prose numbers, and must be masked. Both lines must score zero.

h4_unit_gap.md.why: REGRESSION. Real prose wrote '5 business days'. H4 required the unit to follow the numeral IMMEDIATELY, so an adjective between them turned a compliant numerals-with-units usage into a violation. The unit is now sought within the next three tokens. Line 1 and line 2 must score zero; line 3 ('3 critical risks', no unit anywhere near) remains a true violation.

h5_span.md.why: REGRESSION. The H5 pattern matched only the final digit before the symbol, so a 30% violation reported its span as '0%'. Spans feed the correction messages the agent learns from, so a truncated span degrades every correction built on it. Count is 1; the span assertion lives in test_checker.py.

h14_sentence_initial.md.why: REGRESSION. H14 patterns were matched case-sensitively, so 'The reader' and 'One should' at the start of a sentence were invisible while the same words mid-sentence counted. Found by the injector round-trip, not by the fixture suite. Both lines are violations.

clean_document.md.why: A fully compliant document. The most important fixture in the suite: an instrument that fires on clean text inflates both arms and flattens the curve.

false_positive_guards.md.why: Every documented false-positive shape, one per line: H1 sentence-initial adverbial comma, H8 possessive 's, H3 adjectival participle, H11 numeric range. All four must score zero.

dirty_document.md.why: H10 carries 8 hype words against a cap of 5, so capped and uncapped counts must differ. This is the fixture that proves the cap is applied and the raw count is still recorded.
